reviewed_boundaries: Closed eight-string answer/cancel command subset, positive expected revision, attempt zero through three and canonical nested answer payload match the native decoder.
UTF-8 prose byte limits and domain-separated SHA-256 match native text/command-bytes/hash sources.

Five-field early denial and nine-field committed receipt correlate exact request, command hash and Run. Full rejection permits current head conflict while accepted answer retains waiting and accepted cancel records canceled.
Prepared requests retain original immutable canonical bytes in a client-owned WeakMap; current opaque session and invalidation generation fence prepare, send and completion.
Malformed or mismatched replies remain outcome_unknown; explicit retry resends the same prepared bytes, concurrent reuse is refused, and no automatic retry occurs.
A matching in-flight receipt may reconcile after capability withdrawal in the same session; withdrawal prevents subsequent sends.
Answer records clarification without resuming execution. Canceled receipt records durable transition and stop intent, not process exit, rollback or native effect completion.
limitations: No Hoon compilation or native execution in this review.
No endpoint, capability advertisement, UI integration, worker launch or browser execution.
No authority is asserted by the caller; final native gates remain required.
